cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose which biscuits we're taking to the neighbourhood meeting. Put the best plate in front of me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the new committee's first chance to see what we bring. Give me a plate I'd be happy to put my name on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody will notice who brought them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put your name on the plate and carry it in yourself. You can make the introduction; I'll choose where it goes.
